text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT opened — Streaming latency SLO breach (p99). Paging oncall: @sre-oncall. Incident ID INC-4345. Affected: SSE/WebSocket streaming routes. Symptom: trailing chunk stalls and proxy write timeouts. Triggered 2026-03-17T12:34:56Z
sre-oncall: Ack. I'm on it. Marking P1 and starting triage.
alex: Seeing p95 ~ 320ms, p99 jumped to 3.4s across eu-west and us-east. Proxy 504s up ~4x. Dash: https://dashboards.redwood/streaming/latency (link)
monica: Logs show repeated `write ECONNRESET` from proxy -> edge and long `send` queues in proxy. Client window sizes shrinking. Looks like slow-consumer/backpressure.
jordan: Recent proxy keepalive tweak deployed at 11:50 might be related. Can we revert config in one region first? :thinking:
alex: Starting regional revert in us-east now: `kubectl -n gateway rollout restart deploy/proxy-gateway --context=prod-useast` — doing a canary restart.
incident-bot: Notifying eng-runtime and eng-infra oncall.
support-bot: Customer Impact: ~5% of streaming requests experienced stalls >30s; 2 customer-reported timeouts (CS-2378, CS-2381).
monica: Immediate mitigations proposed:
- enable `evict_slow_clients=true` on proxy
- bump proxy write timeout from 20s -> 45s (short-term)
- add +2 replicas to proxy pool in affected zones
- fail open to fallback model variant for long-lived streams
jordan: I flipped `evict_slow_clients=true` in us-east, applied 2 extra replicas. Watching.
alex: After evict + scale in us-east: p99 dropped 3.4s -> 0.9s. us-west still showing tail spikes.
eng-runtime-bot: Suggestion: route heavy streaming customers to the fallback model-quantized variant while we stabilize (less per-token time, reduces tail). Can be configured per-route.
monica: Also enabling aggressive KV cache prefixing to reduce generation tail work for streaming sessions.
eng-oncall: I'll take the formal handoff at 13:00 UTC. Leaving runbook notes here. Root-cause hypothesis: combination of proxy keepalive regression + slow consumer buildup at edge causing internal write stalls and backpressure into the runtime.
sre-oncall: Action items list:
1) Keep `evict_slow_clients=true` until further notice
2) Revert keepalive change in all regions if canary confirms improvement
3) Temporarily increase proxy pool and write timeout
4) Run `scripts/stream-dump --since 15m --filter=trace_id` and upload artifacts
5) Coordinate customer comms with Support
alex: Uploading traces/logs: https://s3.redwood/INC-4345/ (trace ids: t-9f1, t-9f2, t-9f3) :thumbsup:
support-bot: Noted. CS team has reached out to affected customers and offered expedited support and a postmortem summary.
incident-bot: Incident moved to Mitigation state. Handoff scheduled: sre-oncall -> eng-oncall at 13:00 UTC. If p99 rises above 1.5s again, escalate to infra lead.
eng-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll dig into proxy codepath traces and coordinate a rollback if needed. Will update in 15m.
sre-oncall: Closing initial paging notification. Channel remains open for postmortem tasks and RCA.
__notes: Flat JSON: metadata + thread text. Messages are short, Slack-like, include bot and human participants.
